notes: The source page and text are for the Registered Veterinary Technicians Job Skills Certificate (17.5 units), not the Animal Science A.S. Degree. No section for the A.S. Degree appears in the text, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers are recorded for the named award.
The section heading recorded is the only heading printed; it belongs to a different award. A reviewer should locate the Animal Science A.S. Degree page in the 2026-2027 catalog.

The certificate section lists ANSC B83 through ANSC B96 (all required, 17.5 units), three program learning outcomes specific to the Job Skills Certificate, and names 'Animal Health Technicians' as a job title; these were not recorded because they belong to the certificate, not the A.S. Degree.
Source URL slug references 'summer-2019', suggesting the page may reflect an older certificate version.
